<!-- Target develop for normal changes; only develop promotes to main. Titles are unrestricted. -->

## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue.

## Validation

List meaningful checks and results. Separate host/browser tests from physical board testing.
For firmware changes, include current flash/SRAM/CCM and stack/foreground impact.

## Review

- [ ] Documentation and Client help reflect the change, or no update is needed.
- [ ] Note ownership, release routes and existing capacity are preserved where affected.
- [ ] No private identifiers, captures, backups or unreviewed generated artifacts are included.
- [ ] Third-party notices are retained; original contributions use GPL-3.0-or-later.

## Remaining limits

State untested hardware paths, migration concerns or release qualifications.
